notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.notes:
Thanks to the players who have reported issues using our new in-game reporting feature, thanks to your help we have been able to discover and fix the following issues


Fixed issue with newsfeed not loading correctly
Fixed issue when playing Airstrike cards
Fixed issue when selecting some Event cards in the Combat phase


~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.notes:
In this latest update to the game we have fixed the following issues:

Fixed issue that caused Rules to not be displayed properly.
Fixed crashes that may occur when playing Mud, Truly Famous General: Patton or Malmédy Massacre cards.
Fixed crash in hit allocation screen.
Fixed crash that occurs when loading or resuming a saved game.
Fixed crash that occurs when AI is evaluating Bridge Demolition choices.

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
We've just released the second patch which fixes the following issues.


Added option to switch off the confirm place and move prompts
AI will now automatically move to the next turn if the player cannot play any of their event cards
Added option to switch off fullscreen weather effects
Fixed bug that caused player to get stuck in Hit Assign screen if a unit Blitzed


We hope you enjoy the update.

~The HexWar Team

notes.title: Patch 1 released!
notes.notes:
We've just released the first patch which improves the following:

The in-hand Units and Events cards selection at the bottom left now highlight if a card is usable.
Target frame rate for the game has now been set to 60 FPS.
The webpage the news button links to in the main menu has been updated.
Game icon now displays correctly on the Mac.

Thank you for supporting our games!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
We're going to be releasing Nuts!: The Battle of the Bulge on the 12th Feb for PC and Mac! 

The new Steam edition of the game includes a new 'game log' so you can optionally see all the actions and dice rolls and it also has new Steam Achievements, Trading Cards and Cloud Saves.

Big thanks again to everyone who voted for the game on Greenlight :)

~ The HexWar Games Team
